# `Q-27-3` — Unknown Nav-Button

> An entry in `nav-buttons` is not a known alias, so it was left out of the navbar.

## What this means

A dashboard's `nav-buttons` option adds links to the navbar. Each entry
is either a map describing the link or the name of a share-link alias:

```yaml
format:
  dashboard:
    nav-buttons:
      - twitter
      - icon: gitlab
        href: https://gitlab.com/
```

The aliases are `linkedin`, `facebook`, `reddit` and `twitter`. Quarto
warns with this code when an entry is a name that is not one of them.
The rest of the navbar renders without it.

## Why this happens

- The name is misspelled, or is not one of the aliases.
- The entry is `github`. Quarto 1 found the repository URL itself; Quarto
  2 does not support that alias yet.

## How to fix

Use one of the aliases, or describe the link as a map with an `href`
and, optionally, `icon` (a Bootstrap icon name), `text`, `title`,
`rel`, `target` and `aria-label`:

```yaml
nav-buttons:
  - icon: github
    href: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>
```
